subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should the Control UI add a channel-specific separated/merged session view, and if so should it be a narrow filter over existing session rows or part of the broader sessions workspace in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901?
rationale: The request is a new user-facing session-state surface whose merged timeline behavior affects privacy, routing, transcript aggregation, and Gateway protocol semantics; current source shows no existing channel-view contract to wire up directly.

options.title: Fold into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Treat this issue as the channel-view subset of the broader sessions workspace and design the shared contract once.

options.title: Build Narrow Control UI Filter
options.body: Add channel tabs or filters only over existing Control UI session rows, without a merged transcript timeline.

options.title: Defer Channel View
options.body: Leave the current sessions table unchanged until maintainers prioritize multi-channel monitoring.

recommendation.title: Fold into Sessions Workspace
recommendation.body: Treat this issue as the channel-view subset of the broader sessions workspace and design the shared contract once.

likelyOwner.reason: The available current-main blame and recent bounded history most consistently point to Peter Steinberger on the current Sessions page/protocol surface, with medium confidence because the checkout history is grafted.
